title: Canopy Park
purpose: A playful decompression loop beside the mall where curiosity produces a brief, harmless transformation.
inspirationPolicy: Apply general Nintendo design principles through original Kindred forms and interactions; do not copy Mario assets, characters, layouts, collectibles, branding, or audio.

hero.function: orientation landmark and optional three-petal activation finale

circulation.type: single compact loop with open mall threshold

productionCamera.constraint: hero and at least one discovery cue should be readable without manual camera rotation

interaction.reward: visual, particle and sound transformation only
